name: @atusy/tsudoi
//exports: TYPES ONLY, deliberately. `./types` is the whole published surface: no `main`, no `bin`. An installed copy CANNOT RUN under Deno today (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING, measured under deno 2.9.2 against a packed-and-installed consumer, while bun runs it fine), so publishing a runnable entry point here would ship that defect under this package's name. A runnable distribution is its own backlog item; when it lands, `main` and `bin` are added THERE, with the Deno story solved, not here. Note also that `exports` makes every path NOT listed unreachable by bare specifier, so adding an entry is a decision about the public surface, never a convenience.
